question: BHJL is related to FLNP in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, HNPR is related to LRTV. To which of the following is JPRT related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic: (4) is added to the position values according to the English alphabetic series.

​​So,

BHJL is related to FLNP​ 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/df525e23a1aea37b6bd00b0a4f2f33a766f79a76281dea3e8e5fee24ccec8234.png] 

​And,

HNPR is related to LRTV

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a0cb3b409efa938155bd8aff664541f32c6e43769048feb614887002b4e9f64.png] 

​Similarly,

JPRT is related to

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b810958bb3f65cfda0fa79cb63fc6faafa3a3e5d6b47150795df28fe4cf23f34.png] 

Hence, "Option - (4)" is the correct answer.
